notes: Both volume probes now survive a sleeping endpoint. Check Kontext and Test LoRAs work by handing ComfyUI a graph it must refuse and reading the refusal — but on a cold endpoint the synchronous call gives up before the worker has finished booting and answers with a job id and IN_PROGRESS instead, leaving no refusal to read. That is what 'Couldn't read the model list' followed by a raw job object was. The probe now recognises an unfinished job and polls it to completion, for up to three minutes, before reading the answer — with a log line saying the worker is booting so the wait is legible. The check also says up front that a sleeping endpoint means a couple of minutes' wait.
